name: nop-datav
description: Drive nop-datav from empty shell to full BI dashboard/screen platform: model foundation + dashboard/panel CRUD (D0), panel runtime rendering + data binding + refresh (D1), global filter & linkage (D2), permission/share/export (D3), free-canvas screen + decorator components + carousel/fit (D4), scheduled report & lightweight alerting (D5), AI/ChatBI integration via nop-ai (D6). Reuses nop-report datasets, nop-metadata semantic layer, nop-auth permission model, nop-job scheduling, nop-message notifications.
